transcript: through February 27, it’s Chicago Theater Week: half-priced tickets at many Chicago performance venues so my friend and I on a whim decided to go to the Mercury Theater and see Women of Soul. now the Mercury theater in southport avenue is a perfect space — it's not too big not too small and by the way next month they're hosting that off-Bway production of Winnie the Poo before the show we went next door and had a few drinks at Venue Cabaret Theatre It’s a really cute space - I Hope it finds its audience now for the show I am so glad we saw it - one of the most fun nights I've had at the theater in a really long time they I draw you in with names like Aretha, Donna, Diana Tina —  but you also learn about Big Mama Thornton and Mahalia Jackson it was great to learn about these under represented women of soul now let's talk about the cast every single person in this cast has a voice that k!ller it — it was amazing my mind was constantly blown not a weak link And while this is a Mercury theater production, most of the creatives the actors the writer director Daryl D Brooks all come from Black Ensemble Theater, and if you like this show you will love what they do at Black Ensemble Theater — we had such great time!
